All apps can be installed from the Microsoft Store.

after.question: What is the usual default installation folder for a 64-bit desktop application on 64-bit Windows?

reasons: Nu exclude update-uri automate de drivere sau firmware în mod fals.

before.question: Which types of updates can be configured to occur automatically on most devices? (Choose 2.)
before.explanation: Updates can be automatic for the Windows operating system and most applications. Driver updates are generally not automatic, and firmware updates exist only for certain devices such as Surface.

after.question: Which TWO listed software categories commonly support automatic software updates?
after.explanation: Operating systems and applications commonly support automatic software updates. Drivers and supported firmware can also be updated automatically; physically replacing components is not a software update.

reasons: Delimitează categorii de update relevante pentru securitate.

before.question: Which of the following options can Windows Update install automatically? (Choose 2.)
before.explanation: Critical updates and Windows Security definition updates are automatic. Firmware and app updates are not automatic by default.

after.question: Which TWO listed Windows Update categories provide malware-definition updates and high-priority fixes, respectively?
options: General Microsoft Store app feature updates
after.explanation: Definition updates refresh malware detection data; critical updates deliver high-priority fixes. Supported drivers and firmware can also be delivered by Windows Update, so they should not be treated as universally non-automatic.

reasons: Nu se poate deduce o permisiune lipsă numai din ediție.

before.question: An employee brings a laptop in from home to connect to the corporate domain-based network. The laptop cannot join a domain. The employee is running Windows Enterprise. What is the most likely cause of the inability to join a domain?
options: The user needs to be a member of the Domain Admins group
The user needs the Create computer object permission in Active Directory
The laptop needs to be running Windows Pro
The user needs to have Domain join installed
before.explanation: To join a domain, a user needs the Create computer object permission in Active Directory. Domain Admins membership is not required, and Enterprise can already join a domain.

after.question: A Windows Enterprise laptop can reach the domain controller. DNS and credentials are correct, but the user has no delegated join rights and the default machine-account quota is zero. Which permission can an administrator delegate to let the user create its computer account in the target OU?
options: The user needs to be a member of the Domain Admins group
The user needs the Create computer object permission in Active Directory
The laptop needs to be running Windows Pro
The user needs to have Domain join installed
after.explanation: Delegating Create Computer objects in the target OU is one way to authorize creation of the new domain computer account. Domain Admin membership is not required. Other join failures need their own diagnostics.

reasons: Instalarea tuturor aplicațiilor nu cere admin; specifică instalare system-wide.

before.question: On a Windows device, which account level and permission level, at a minimum, are needed to install apps on that device?
options: Standard user with domain administrative privileges
Standard user with local administrative privileges

after.question: A standard user needs to install a desktop app that writes to protected system folders and requires elevation. What is the minimum scope of administrative privileges required?
options: Local administrative privileges supplied through UAC

after.question: Which power setting, when enabled, stores files in RAM while a laptop is inactive?
after.explanation: Sleep mode keeps data in RAM; Hibernate stores it on the hard drive; Shutdown loses unsaved data.

after.question: A user wants different windows on a laptop screen and an external monitor instead of mirroring the same content. Which display mode should the user select?
after.explanation: Extend these displays creates an extended desktop. To put the laptop display on the left, arrange its monitor icon to the left in Display settings.

before.question: A laptop has two USB-A ports and one USB-C port. An external drive is connected to a USB-A port, an iPhone with a USB-C cable must be plugged in occasionally, and an external monitor with an HDMI port must be connected. Choose the correct answer for each statement.

An external storage device is typically connected to a computer using:

after.question: A laptop has USB-A and USB-C ports. Its USB-C port supports DisplayPort Alt Mode. Consider an active USB-A graphics adapter with its required driver installed. Match each statement to the correct answer.

options: Change the icon images of the Start Menu items

options: Link to the device manufacturer's support site for a driver
Browse the host device for a driver

Search the host device for a driver

options: Open a direct link to the manufacturer's support site
Change the file system of the device

reasons: Management imprimantă vs acces consolă; scenariu cere două drepturi.

options: Assign the technician the Manage Documents permission
Assign the technician the Manage Printers permission
Add the technician to the Administrators group for the network on which the printer resides
Assign the technician the Print permission

after.question: A technician needs to change a printer configuration and cancel print jobs submitted by other users. Which TWO printer permissions should be assigned directly?
options: Assign the technician the Manage Documents permission
Assign the technician the Manage Printers permission
Add the technician to the Administrators group for the network on which the printer resides
Assign the technician the Print permission

The permissions on the files are retained
The source and destination permissions are combined

after.question: You are reorganizing the drive on your computer. You move several files to a new folder located on the same partition. options: The destination folder permissions are inherited
The permissions on the files are retained
The source and destination permissions are combined

options: Files and folders are moved to a new partition
Files and folders are moved within the same partition
Files and folders are copied to a new partition
Files and folders are copied within the same partition
after.explanation: Permissions are retained only when files or folders are moved within the same partition. Copies are new files and inherit permissions from the parent folder.

The permissions from the source partition remain with the file or folder

after.question: When a file or folder is moved or copied from one partition to another, what happens to the permissions of that file or folder? Assume NTFS source and destination and a normal File Explorer operation without an explicit ACL-preservation tool.
options: The permissions inherit from the folder of the destination partition
The permissions from the source partition are retained with the file or folder
The users and groups assigned to the resource in the source partition are copied to the new partition
The permissions from the source partition remain with the file or folder
after.explanation: The destination partition can have different users and groups, so the file inherits permissions from its new parent folder.

reasons: Separă drepturi SMB Advanced Sharing de etichete Basic Sharing.

before.question: A new technician is learning the distinction between file permissions and share permissions. Identify each set of permissions.

dropZones.label: Full Control, Modify, and Read & Execute are ___ permissions.

before.explanation: According to the exam material, Full Control, Modify and Read & Execute are file permissions, while Read/Write and Owner are share permissions.

after.question: A new technician is learning the distinction between file permissions and share permissions. Identify each set of permissions.

dropZones.label: Full Control, Modify, and Read & Execute are NTFS ___ permissions.
Read, Change, and Full Control in Advanced Sharing are SMB ___ permissions.

after.explanation: NTFS file permissions include Modify and Read & Execute. Advanced SMB sharing offers Read, Change, and Full Control. Basic sharing UI labels are not the same permission list.

reasons: Full și Mirror sunt distractori plauzibili; cere comparație incremental/differential.

before.question: In a backup strategy that creates a Full Backup once a week, which type, when created on day 4, is quicker to restore?
before.explanation: A differential restore needs only two steps: the last full backup and the latest differential. Incremental needs all increments since the full backup.

after.question: After a weekly full backup, which nightly backup type normally needs only that full backup plus the latest nightly backup for a restore?
after.explanation: Differential restore normally requires the full backup and latest differential. Incremental restore requires the full backup plus each subsequent incremental in order.

reasons: Înlocuiește creșterea strictă obligatorie.

before.question: Backups and restores: Each differential backup in between full backups gets larger in size.
before.explanation: A differential backup copies everything changed since the last full backup, so each one is larger than the previous.

after.question: Between full backups, differential backups generally contain more changed data as additional files change.
after.explanation: Differential backups accumulate changes since the latest full backup. They need not grow every single time; no changes, deletions, compression and implementation affect size.

reasons: Scalability include vertical și orizontal, nu doar instanțe.

before.question: A new cloud administrator learns that a virtual machine can be configured to increase or decrease its RAM dynamically based on workload demand. Which cloud feature is this describing?
before.explanation: Elasticity adjusts resources such as RAM or CPU up or down for a workload. Scalability adds or removes instances, and load balancing distributes work among servers.

after.question: A new cloud administrator learns that a virtual machine can be configured to increase or decrease its RAM dynamically based on workload demand. Which cloud feature is this describing?
after.explanation: Elasticity is automatic adjustment of resource allocation with changing demand. Scalability is the ability to increase capacity vertically or horizontally, whether manually or automatically. Load balancing distributes work; a reserved instance concerns a reservation/pricing arrangement.

reasons: Basic sharing permite utilizatori selectați; nu nega acest fapt.

before.question: Permissions and shares: Basic shares allow for custom permissions to users and groups.
before.explanation: Advanced shares allow custom permissions to users and groups.

after.question: Advanced Sharing offers more granular share configuration than the basic Windows sharing wizard.
after.explanation: Advanced Sharing exposes share-level permissions and settings such as connection limits. The basic wizard can still grant access to selected users.

reasons: Nu promite acces tuturor indiferent de ACL.

before.question: Permissions and shares: Files in public shares on a device are available to all accounts on that device.
before.explanation: Public shares are available to all accounts on the device.

after.question: Files in C:\Users\Public can normally be shared with local users, subject to their NTFS permissions.
after.explanation: Public folders are designed for sharing. Custom ACLs can restrict access; they do not override NTFS security.

reasons: Take ownership diferă de Change permissions.

before.question: A new technician is learning the meaning of permissions on network drives. What does the Take Ownership permission give someone that is unavailable with other permissions besides Full Control?
options: The ability to write to the resource
The ability to control attributes on a resource
The ability to modify a resource
The ability to control permissions of a resource
before.explanation: Take Ownership allows controlling the permissions on a file or folder. Modify, Write and attribute permissions do not.

after.question: What does the NTFS Take ownership permission allow a user to do?
options: Make themselves the owner of a file or folder
Bypass all file permissions without changing ownership
after.explanation: Take ownership allows taking ownership. An owner can normally change the DACL to grant access, but taking ownership does not itself decrypt an EFS file.

reasons: Nu confunda segment labels cu profiluri Windows Firewall.

before.question: Match each network type typically found in a business with its description.

A network that has its resources protected from outside access
A network that is separated from other networks in an organization and typically allows internet access but keeps people away from important company resources

before.explanation: Public networks face the internet, private networks protect resources, and guest networks are separated and give internet access only.

after.question: Match the informal business-network segment labels to their roles. These labels describe this design, not Windows firewall profiles.

dropZones.label: An external-facing network that interacts with the internet
A network that has its resources protected from outside access

reasons: Intranet nu trebuie să fie complet deconectat de Internet.

before.explanation: An intranet is internal and confidential to the organization.

after.question: An intranet is a private network or site intended for an organization’s authorized users; it may still use Internet-connected infrastructure.
after.explanation: Private access, not a total absence of Internet connectivity, defines an intranet.

reasons: Smart card poate face operații criptografice; cere rolul în autentificare.

before.question: You work for a computer support company that has a contract to provide high-security services. You have been given a smart card. What is the purpose of a smart card?
before.explanation: A smart card is typically used for authentication. It contains a small CPU and a small amount of storage, but it is not used as a storage device or to encrypt/decrypt data.

after.question: A high-security workplace issues a smart card to a user as a sign-in credential. What is its primary role in this scenario?
after.explanation: The card serves as an authentication credential. Smart cards can store protected keys and perform cryptographic operations; it would be incorrect to say they never encrypt, decrypt or sign data.

reasons: Precizează procesare LSDOU fără excepții.

after.question: Group Policy precedence: For Group Policy, OU settings override domain settings. Assume normal Local–Site–Domain–OU processing, no enforced links, no blocked inheritance, and conflicting settings for the same scope.
after.explanation: The priority order is OU, Domain, Site, Local, so OU settings override domain settings.

reasons: Elimină sinonimele selective wipe.

dropZones.label: A phone has its business data deleted but the personal data is still on the phone.
A mobile device is reset to its factory settings.

after.question: For each situation, indicate which type of wipe is taking place on a device.

dropZones.label: A phone has its business data deleted but the personal data is still on the phone.
A mobile device is reset to its factory settings.

reasons: Geofencing MDM nu este universal.

before.question: A network administrator wants to track mobile device movement so a device can be disabled if it is outside travel boundaries set by the company. What features need to be turned on so this tracking can take place? (Choose 2.)

after.question: A management solution supports location-based monitoring on both Android and iOS. Which OS location settings are needed for location access? (Choose 2.)
after.explanation: The relevant location setting must be enabled and app permission granted on each platform. Availability of monitoring/geofencing depends on the management solution and enrollment mode.

reasons: UAC elevează procesul, nu schimbă tipul contului.

before.question: Which permission elevation takes place during the use of UAC?
options: Backup operator permissions to standard accounts
before.explanation: UAC grants temporary administrative permissions to standard user accounts to change Windows settings or install apps.

after.question: What does UAC allow when a standard user supplies valid administrator credentials for an operation that requires elevation?
options: Permanent conversion of the user to a guest
Permanent conversion of the user to an administrator
Running the requested operation with administrative privileges
Automatic removal of all security restrictions
after.explanation: UAC elevates the authorized operation/process. It does not permanently change a standard account into an administrator account.

reasons: UAC nu este o tehnologie biometrică și nu schimbă contul.

before.question: Which Windows authentication technology can grant temporary administrative permissions to standard user accounts for the purpose of changing Windows settings or installing apps?
before.explanation: User Account Control (UAC) can grant temporary administrative permissions to standard user accounts.

after.question: Which Windows security feature can request administrator credentials when a standard user starts an operation requiring elevation?
after.explanation: User Account Control handles elevation prompts. With valid administrator credentials, the requested process can run with administrative privileges.

reasons: MDM poate folosi clientul integrat, nu obligatoriu app separată.

before.question: For a mobile device to enroll in an MDM server for management purposes, what needs to be installed on that mobile device?
before.explanation: An agent (usually an app, sometimes a certificate) lets the device enroll with and communicate with the MDM server. Intune is itself an MDM server.

after.question: An MDM solution requires a separate client app on the device. What is the general name of that management client?
after.explanation: A separate management client is often called an agent. Other MDM implementations can use built-in OS enrollment components instead.

reasons: Replay attack nu demonstrează keylogging; explicit captură taste.

Information and activity are stolen and then used to launch a replay attack at a later date.
